Players Committee card image of [[Ortugg (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While at a Jabba's Palace site, your other Gamorreans are deploy -1 and forfeit +3. Permanent weapon is •Ortugg's Ax (may target a character or creature for free; draw destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Dark/large/ortugg.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af72c4491442a863d743950ff8a472ed77b3 eb53af7] (1 December 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
